name: generate_clarification_response
description: Generate a structured response when multiple questions need to be asked for RFQ completion

progress_acknowledgment.description: Acknowledge the progress made so far and what information has been collected.

questions.description: List of questions to ask the user. Use the questions provided from the data model. Present them clearly and organized.

reason.description: Brief explanation of why this information is needed. Focus on RFQ completion requirements, not vendor selection promises.
